name.es: Flecha de Ø5 mm con plano
name.fr: Arbre de Ø5 mm à méplat
name.pt: Eixo de Ø5 mm com rebaixo

description.en: A hardened, ground Ø5 mm g6 shaft cut to length, with a flat (D cut) for set screws. A Voron 2.4-class Z drive's output shaft is one 60 mm long: three 625 bearings carry it, and it holds the 80-tooth reduction pulley and the 20-tooth Z belt pulley.
description.es: Una flecha templada y rectificada de Ø5 mm g6 cortada a medida, con un plano (corte en D) para los prisioneros. La flecha de salida de un accionamiento Z de clase Voron 2.4 es una de 60 mm: la sostienen tres rodamientos 625 y lleva la polea de reducción de 80 dientes y la polea de 20 dientes de la banda Z.
description.fr: Un arbre trempé et rectifié de Ø5 mm g6 coupé à longueur, avec un méplat (coupe en D) pour les vis de pression. L'arbre de sortie d'un entraînement Z de classe Voron 2.4 en est un de 60 mm : trois roulements 625 le portent, et il tient la poulie de réduction à 80 dents et la poulie à 20 dents de la courroie Z.
description.pt: Um eixo temperado e retificado de Ø5 mm g6 cortado à medida, com um rebaixo (corte em D) para os parafusos de fixação. O eixo de saída de um acionamento Z de classe Voron 2.4 é um de 60 mm: três rolamentos 625 sustentam-no e ele leva a polia de redução de 80 dentes e a polia de 20 dentes da correia Z.

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of end face A, on the shaft axis. +z runs along the axis to end face B at z = length_mm. +x is an arbitrary radial reference (the flat for the set screws is not an interface: a pulley's set screw finds it at assembly). Each journal sits where a 625's face B lands, the bearing lying toward end A (its face A 5 mm nearer end A); both journal and hub normals follow the side the partner's body lies on.

z_drive_length.note: the Voron 2.4r2 Z drive's 5x60 shaft; the default of length_mm

bearing_625_width.note: a 625's width; a journal sits at its face B, 5 past its face A

parameters.note: MISUMI's configurable range and increment; the default is the Voron 2.4r2 Z drive's 60 mm (source 2). No frame reads it: keep every station within it.

interfaces.note: Male: the shaft passes through a 625's inner ring. The origin is where that bearing's face B lands, journal_a_mm from end A; the normal points −z, so the bearing (bearing-625.bore is framed at face B, normal +z) lies between the origin and end A.

Male: the shaft passes through a 625's inner ring. The origin is where that bearing's face B lands, journal_b_mm from end A; the normal points −z, so the bearing (bearing-625.bore is framed at face B, normal +z) lies between the origin and end A.

Male: the shaft passes through a 625's inner ring. The origin is where that bearing's face B lands, journal_c_mm from end A; the normal points −z, so the bearing (bearing-625.bore is framed at face B, normal +z) lies between the origin and end A.
Male: a pulley's bore slides on here, its face A (or face B, by the pulley's bore_b) landing at hub_a_mm; the normal points −z, so the pulley lies toward end A.
Male: as hub_a, with the normal +z, so the pulley lies toward end B.

notes: The stations are an assembly's choices: the closure check holds them to the housing's bearing seats and the pulleys' planes. The D cut's depth is not cited and not modelled.
